title: Understanding Machine Learning
description: How do machines actually learn? Let's discover Machine Learning, the engine that powers most modern AI.

content.value: Machine Learning (ML) is a part of AI where computers learn patterns from examples instead of being given exact step-by-step instructions. Show it enough examples, and it figures out the rules by itself!
In traditional programming, a human writes every rule. In Machine Learning, we give the computer examples and the answers, and it discovers the rules on its own.

Traditional Programming:
   Rules + Data  ➜  Answers
   (a human writes the rules)

Machine Learning:
   Data + Answers  ➜  Rules
   (the computer learns the rules)

Imagine teaching a friend to spot a spam message. You show them lots of real spam ('You won a free prize!!!') and lots of normal messages. After enough examples, they start to notice the patterns. Machine Learning works the same way, it learns from many labeled examples until it can make good guesses on new ones.
Activity: 'Human AI Game': Be the machine! A friend shows you cards with a hidden pattern (like 'animals that fly'). Guess the pattern from the examples. That's exactly what an ML model does!
Key Takeaway: Machine Learning allows computers to learn patterns from data, instead of following hand-written rules.
